questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

Monolithic
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"monolithic"** refers to something that is large, powerful, and intractably indivisible and uniform. (एकसमान और विशाल)

 
 
• **Example: **The company turned into a monolithic organization, resistant to change and innovation.
 
 
 
• **"Huge"** means extremely large, enormous in size or extent. (विशाल)
 
 
• **Example: **The skyscraper was a huge structure, dominating the city skyline.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'huge'** best expresses the meaning of **'monolithic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Written **(लिखित): Something that is expressed or documented in writing.

 
 
• **Example:** The written instructions were clear and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• **Minute **(सूक्ष्म): Extremely small in size or amount.
 
 
• **Example: **The minute details in the painting were remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Cramped** (संकीर्ण): Uncomfortably small or restricted in space.
 
 
• **Example:** The cramped room barely had enough space for a bed and a desk.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

Fledgling
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Apprentice'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Fledgling'** is a **noun **and it means **'a young bird that has grown feathers and is learning to fly' **so that the similar word of **'Fledgling'** is **'Apprentice'**.

 
 
• Example: Emily, a young and enthusiastic birdwatcher, spotted a **fledgling **robin perched on a low branch, still learning to fly.
 
 
 
• The word "**apprentice**" refers to a person who is learning a trade or profession under the guidance and supervision of a skilled practitioner. An apprentice typically undergoes a period of practical training and learning in order to acquire the necessary skills and knowledge for the chosen occupation.
 
 
• Example sentence: "Sarah decided to become an **apprentice **at a renowned bakery to learn the art of pastry-making from a master baker."
 
 
 
• Hence the correct **similar** word is **Apprentice**.

 
 

 **WORDS**
 **MEANING**
 
 

 Wild(adjective)
 (of an animal or plant) living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.
 
 

 Fugitive(noun)
 a person who has escaped from a place or is in hiding, especially to avoid arrest or persecution.
 
 

 Ancient(adjective)
 belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.
